candidates.explanation: With FILE_DRIVER=local, the transform builds the file URL from appConfig().frontendDomain instead of backendDomain. Local files are served by the backend, so serialized photo paths (e.g. in GET /auth/me) get the web app host prefix and don't load.

fix.description: Use backendDomain for the local driver branch.
